## Compliance Requirements

When distributing binary packages or redistributing source code containing these components:
- Retain all original copyright, patent, trademark, and attribution notices from the upstream source code.
- Provide a copy of the corresponding license texts ([`LICENSE-APACHE`](xbuild/LICENSE-APACHE) and/or [`LICENSE-MIT`](xbuild/LICENSE-MIT)).
- Review the specific `NOTICE.md` file in each component directory for detailed module-level attribution.
